model_correction_this_round.what: the composition of quality and trait bonuses
model_correction_this_round.old: multiplier = quality_factor * (1 + trait_bonus), so a Tier I emblem scored 0.10 of its stat
model_correction_this_round.new: multiplier = 1 + quality_bonus + net_trait_bonus, exactly as the client prints it
model_correction_this_round.evidence: all nine observed emblems reproduce to the digit; the old rule reproduced none
model_correction_this_round.consequence: the real multiplier range is about 1.1 to 2.6 rather than 0.09 to 3.15, so a banner reweights the stats far less violently than the pre-banner model assumed

action_taken_since.action: USE ROLL OPTION C2 (reroll quality of the first red emblem) on the MID banner
action_taken_since.outcome: Mid red quality rolled Tier I -> Tier II, which also made the three qualities II/III/I all distinct and switched Fractal on for the blue emblem

counterfactual_model_validation_2.finding: The Tier II branch of the quality reroll was enumerated in advance as +739, arising from +0.20 on the red emblem AND +0.60 on the blue one because the three qualities would become all-distinct and switch Fractal on. The client now shows exactly 180 / 210 / 140 with trait lines +50 / +50 / +30.
counterfactual_model_validation_2.why_it_matters: The Fractal activation is a cross-slot consequence of changing a different emblem's quality. Predicting it in advance is a much stronger test than reproducing a static banner.

stat_reroll_operations_exist.finding: The board can offer STAT rerolls (统计数据), not only trait and quality. This is the operation class that can fix a badly-drawn stat such as Wards Placed on a mid.
stat_reroll_operations_exist.note: A stat reroll is guaranteed to produce a new stat and cannot duplicate a stat already on the banner (DOTA_FantasyCraft_Tutorial_Emblems_Stat).

team_change_regenerates_banner.why: If changing a team also regenerates the War Banner, switching Core would put the current banner at risk. That banner is in the top 4 percent of random Core banners (12088 versus a random mean of 6729), so the expected loss from regeneration is about -5360 against a +1334 gain from the better team.
team_change_regenerates_banner.resolution: one token on the operator's TEST account: change any team there and see whether its banner survives. The target account must not be used for this.
